This assertion validates only the per-cycle totals of four `G`, two `y`, and two `r` samples, not that the TLS followed the continuous sequence `GGGGyyrr`; for example, a reordered or interrupted sequence with the same counts would still pass. Although line 78 binds each sample to `tls_states.xml`, the audit never checks consecutive transition times or the complete phase-request trace, so its result cannot independently substantiate the reported actual 4 s green, 2 s yellow, and 2 s red durations used for later safety and actuator-qualification reasoning. Add an ordered per-cycle TLS/switch assertion before emitting this conclusion.
